verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a first-party `extract_rules` parameter (stringified JSON) for data extraction from CSS selectors. Its data-extraction docs explicitly say to use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction, which directly delivers selector-rule field extraction. Missing for 10: documented rule syntax and output-format details (e.g., attribute or list extraction, nested fields), worked extraction examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract specific fields from a page using CSS or XPath selector rules

citations.quote: extract_rules [stringified JSON] ("") Data extraction from CSS selectors
